title: Reference purchasing agent 1.0.0
label: intentionally-vulnerable-fixture
description: Rule-based purchasing agent written by the CounterProof team with two planted defects, so the full loop can be demonstrated. Findings against it are demonstrations, not discoveries.
planted_defects: Budget is checked per purchase, never cumulatively.
Payments carry no idempotency key; repeated requests and timeouts are retried blindly.
provenance: Written for the demonstration with planted defects (see module docstring).

title: Reference purchasing agent 1.1.0 (repaired)
label: repaired-fixture
description: The 1.0.0 fixture with both planted defects repaired: cumulative spend check from settled payments, idempotency keys and status checks instead of blind retries.
provenance: Repair of the 1.0.0 fixture, written by the CounterProof team.

title: LLM purchasing agent 0.1.1 (live model)
label: independent-implementation
description: A conventional tool-calling purchasing agent driven by a hosted language model through the evaluator's model broker. Its decisions come from the model, not from code written to fail; results are statistical and depend on the provider, model and date.
provenance: Prompt and tool loop written once by the CounterProof team before any strategy was run against it; no defects planted. The model is a third-party hosted model.
